appeal.accepted_elements: The replacement IDs, spans, Lev.25.1-26.46 parent, sibling dependency, low confidence for 061a, and supporting relations are correct.
appeal.claim: The 061a hold state is too final. accepted_short_child_with_required_parent does not implement the peer remedy requiring the two-verse child to remain flagged for human review.
appeal.evidence: The child is unusually short, while the samekh after 26.2 and conditional protasis at 26.3 strongly support the seam.
appeal.counterevidence: Lev.26.1-2 supplies the obedience premise for 26.3-13 and can be contextually detached if retrieved alone.
appeal.uncertainty: The seam is high-confidence; the unresolved issue is retrieval fitness and short-child governance, not Hebrew structure.
appeal.exact_remedy: Retain 061a/061b and all relations, but change 061a hold state to deferred_human_or_external_ai_short_child_review or equivalent explicit non-final hold.
